C0076.title: Casino Job Leads to a Lucrative Scheme: He Launched a Traffic Hijacking Service
keywords: illegal control of computer information systems
C0076.summary: According to Procuratorate Daily, in June 2022 Mianzhu police discovered Zhang's abnormal funds and large amounts of gambling-site information while handling an online gambling case, which led to a series of illegal-control-of-computer-information-systems cases. Zhang had worked at a casino in the Philippines and learned about traffic hijacking after seeing users redirected from one casino site to another. After returning to China, he looked for traffic hijacking channels and tried to cooperate with telecom operator personnel. The case shows how overseas gambling-promotion demand can penetrate domestic network resources.
